faq.q: What is the origin of Inayah?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Inayah, inayah. Script forms are عناية, عنایه, عنایہ, इनाया.

faq.q: Is Inayah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
